description: Answers a meeting invitation that arrived as mail, by the message’s `id`: `accepted`, `declined` or `tentative`, with an optional `comment`. The answer is emailed to the organiser, which is how Google, Outlook and Calendly learn it. The message must carry an `invitation` with one of this address’s own addresses on it. The same answer twice sends once.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: respond_to_invitation
title: Accept or decline a meeting
